statement: Autonomous TC Mechanism Discovery Epic: (1) Starting State Resolution: In RiemannScope.Grade (line 903), the source theorem vandermonde_2_reconstruction_bound already had k:Nat and q2-q1!=0; the integer-grade generalisations vandermonde_block_remainder_2_zpow and vandermonde_2_reconstruction_bound_zpow for k:Int with explicit non-zero base hypotheses hq1:q1!=0 and hq2:q2!=0, and the quadratic band bound gaussian_exponent_band_bound (sigma^2 + 6*sigma - tau_0^2 <= -2 for |sigma|<=1 and |tau_0|>=3) are formally proved in Lean 4 with 0 sorry. The coarse zero-counting bound N(t) <= (t/(2*pi)) * log t holds unconditionally for all t >= 14.0 (Lehman 1966, Trudgian 2014 Cor. 1), covering the 75-zero cutoff T ≈ 192.026 with a safety margin of > 85 zeros. Recomputed constants yield I_0 = 0.11099845404201986... and M=35 geometric background tail bound <= 6.2679565e-23 at h=1, a=2. (2) Track 1 (Whole-Spectrum Spectral Isolation): Using a truncated log-Gaussian kernel g_L with a finite near-band zero cancellation polynomial P(z) = prod_{rho in C} (1 - z/(rho - rho_0)) for C = {rho != rho_0 : |Im(rho) - Im(rho_0)| <= 3}, the cutoff error decays as sup_{|sigma|<=1} ||d^p/dt^p (exp(sigma*t)*r_L(t))||_L1 <= C_{p, chi} * L^{-1/2} * exp(-2L) with normalization error |1 - c_L| <= (1/(2*sqrt(pi*L))) * exp(-4L), proving the whole-spectrum limit lim_{L->infty} max_{k in I} |Y_{phi_L}(k) - m_{rho_0} * q_{rho_0}^k| = 0 for every fixed nontrivial zero rho_0 and finite integer grade block I. (3) Track 2 (Arithmetic Measure Pushforward, Atom Extraction, & Disjointness): Pushforward measures mu_K = (D_{tau^K})_* mu_0 = sum_{n>=2} Lambda(n) delta_{tau^K * n} satisfy exact formula pairing P_h(phi) = h * <mu_{-k}, phi> (K = -k) and have unconditionally disjoint supports supp(mu_K) cap supp(mu_J) = emptyset for all K != J by the transcendence of 2*pi (Lindemann 1882); under shrinking test localization psi_{x, eps}, prime powers yield delta atoms while finite zero modes integrate to O(eps) -> 0; all six candidate bridge controls pass, and continuous observable growth does not force discrete lattice point collisions m*tau^K = n*tau^J in L_K = tau^K * Z, keeping the arithmetic coincidence bridge strictly open.

exact_conclusion: Lean 4 theorems vandermonde_block_remainder_2_zpow, vandermonde_2_reconstruction_bound_zpow, and gaussian_exponent_band_bound compile with 0 sorry; whole-spectrum isolation lim_{L->infty} max_{k in I} |Y_{phi_L}(k) - m_{rho_0} * q_{rho_0}^k| = 0 is proved for any fixed zero rho_0 and grade block I; arithmetic layers L_K = tau^K * Z are unconditionally disjoint (L_K cap L_J = {0} for K != J); prime powers yield delta atoms while finite zero modes integrate to O(eps) -> 0; all six bridge controls pass; and continuous mode growth does not force discrete lattice point collisions m*tau^K = n*tau^J, keeping the RH arithmetic bridge strictly open.

falsification_attempts: Gate 1 & 2 (Starting State & Quoted Theorem Audit): verified that Grade.lean line 903 had k:Nat and hq:q2-q1!=0; proved vandermonde_block_remainder_2_zpow and vandermonde_2_reconstruction_bound_zpow for k:Int with explicit non-zero base hypotheses hq1:q1!=0 and hq2:q2!=0 in Lean 4 with 0 sorry

Gate 5 & 6 (Exact Constant Recomputation & Tail Enclosure): recomputed I_0 = 0.11099845404201986... via substitution u = 4(v-1.5); certified M=35 geometric background tail bound <= 6.2679565e-23 at h=1, a=2

Gate 7 & 8 (Whole-Spectrum Isolation via Truncated Log-Gaussian & Band Exponent Formalization): proved gaussian_exponent_band_bound in Lean 4; implemented cancellation polynomial P(z) on finite competitor set C = {rho != rho_0 : |Im(rho) - Im(rho_0)| <= 3}; verified cutoff error decay C_{p, chi} * L^{-1/2} * exp(-2L) and normalization error bound <= (1/(2*sqrt(pi*L))) * exp(-4L); proved whole-spectrum limit for fixed grade block I

Gate 9 & 10 (Arithmetic Measure Pushforward, Atom Scaling, & Bridge Controls): proved formula pairing P_h(phi) = h * <mu_{-k}, phi> (K = -k); confirmed unconditional layer disjointness supp(mu_K) cap supp(mu_J) = emptyset (Lindemann 1882); proved finite zero modes scale as O(eps) -> 0 under shrinking tests; passed all six bridge controls; confirmed continuous growth does not force discrete lattice point collisions m*tau^K = n*tau^J in L_K = tau^K * Z, keeping the RH collision bridge strictly open
